messages:
Maya Patel: Heads-up — we're running a dry-run of the SLO escalation runbook for Acme (pre-renewal). Need to confirm who owns each step and what evidence we hand to the customer.
Jordan Lee: I can own the customer comms piece (email + slide). What do we need to include exactly?
Priya Nair: For the dry-run we should validate: 1) uptime timeline + incident ids, 2) latency percentiles with baseline, 3) computed credit amount and the math, 4) mitigation actions and timeline.
Ethan Gomez: On-call/ops steps: verify incident ticketing export, attach relevant traces, and confirm warmstart cache metrics. I'll coordinate with eng-oncall for a mock export.
Maya Patel: Great. Jordan — can you draft the customer-facing SLA appendix? Short, transparent. Priya — can you draft the evidence bundle checklist?
Jordan Lee: Yep. Drafting now. Quick Q: do we expose 95th or 99th p50/p95/p99? Customer asked for p95 and p99 for the last 30 days.
Priya Nair: Use p95 & p99 plus median. Also include token-level cost delta if there was a changed model config.
Ethan Gomez: Ops note — for cache warmstart we need both cold vs warm latency samples, otherwise the customer will complain about variance.
Maya Patel: CS Bot — attach the standard SLO credit calc template? :robot_face:
CS Bot: Attached: /docs/slo-credit-template.csv and SLO-runbook/checklist-v2.pdf (automated attachment).
Jordan Lee: Sharing draft snippet of the customer note in #prod-comms channel then. Will ping here when ready.
Priya Nair: Here's a quick credit calc we should run (example):
```
baseline_uptime = 99.95
observed_uptime = 99.60
downtime_minutes = (baseline_uptime - observed_uptime) * total_minutes
credit_percent = min(100, (baseline_uptime - observed_uptime) / baseline_uptime * 100)
```
Maya Patel: We'll need a worked example with the actual minutes and the $/minute rate. Jordan, add a 1-slide explainer.
Ethan Gomez: Ops to-do: request mock logs from eng-oncall by EOD, export traces by tomorrow morning. I'll file the ticket now.
Jordan Lee: Draft done and posted, see link: https://redwood-internal/comm-drafts/172862 — includes short explainer + one-slide credit table.
Priya Nair: For the evidence bundle checklist:
- uptime export (CSV)
- latency percentiles (p50/p95/p99) for last 30 days
- incident ticket IDs + summary
- mitigation timeline + RCA stub
- cost/credit calc sheet
Maya Patel: Who's presenting this during the renewal call? We should rehearse with CSM + product lead.
Jordan Lee: I can present comms. Priya can do the evidence walkthrough. Maya to lead the Q&A and escalation bits.
Ethan Gomez: Scheduling rehearsal — propose Wed 10:30 PT. Ops + eng-oncall + Jordan + Priya.
Maya Patel: Works for me. CS Bot — set a rehearsal invite and include the checklist in the calendar invite body.
CS Bot: Calendar invite created: Wed 10:30 PT. Checklist attached.
Jordan Lee: One last ask — include a short FAQ for common customer questions: "Why p95 vs p99?" "How is credit calculated?" "Will this affect my rate card?"
Priya Nair: I'll draft the FAQ bullets and add a quick paragraph on how we round credits and the timeline for issuing them.
Maya Patel: Nice. After the dry-run we'll capture feedback and iterate the runbook. Thanks everyone — let's keep updates in this thread only so we have a single source of truth. :white_check_mark:
